name: legacy-monolith-decomposition
title: Decompose the 12.9k-line legacy.py monolith
description: legacy.py is ~12,919 lines in one file (16x the repo's own 800-line cap); the combine/models/otel/scenarios/schema facades are 7-line re-exports, not real splits. Every change lands in one file and the lint/checklist governance compensates for the structural debt. Plan and execute an incremental, byte-identical-output-preserving decomposition into focused modules.
creator: sdelmas
